title: Major Gifts Assistant
body_text: EMILYs List - Major Gifts Assistant Major Gifts Assistant Washington, DC Development - Major Gifts / Full Time / Hybrid apply for this job SUMMARY Reports to: Major Gifts Director Supervisory Responsibilities: Interns FLSA Status : Non-Exempt Union Position: Yes EMILYs List, the nation’s largest resource for women in politics, is searching for a Major Gifts Assistant to join our Major Gifts team. The Major Gifts Assistant provides administrative support to the Major Gifts team, including database and resource management, research and document preparation, and event coordination. At EMILYs List, you’ll be part of a dynamic team committed to electing Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot. Read on for more details about the job and about EMILYs List. Essential Job Functions Maintain development database in Raiser’s Edge and other team resources and shared documents in both Google Drive and our internal server. Enter and update donor pledges and contributions in Raiser’s Edge. Complete data entry, reporting, and tracking related to fundraising, compliance, and campaigns, ensuring information is organized, updated, and accurate. Process department invoices, including from fundraising consultants and outside vendors. Prepare and mail acknowledgement letters in coordination with the Major Gifts Manager and Executive Office. Conduct donor research, including identifying prospect and upgrade targets. Draft fundraising materials as needed. Provide logistical and administrative support for fundraising events, including tracking RSVP’s, handling donor information, and staffing in-person events. Assist with scheduling and note taking for meetings and events. Work with the Major Gifts Manager, Major Gifts Coordinator, and Major Gifts interns to respond to team requests and donor inquiries. Facilitate collaboration between the Major Gifts team and other departments by working with assistants and coordinators across the organization. Plan and maintain the schedule for the Chief Development Officer. Coordinate hiring, training, and project management for department interns as needed, along with the Major Gifts Manager and Major Gifts Coordinator. Perform other duties as assigned. Adapt to shifting demands and priorities based on event schedules and upcoming elections, including potential travel and occasional work on nights and weekends. Qualifications The ideal candidate will be an organized, detail-oriented self-starter who can work well under pressure, with a variety of people, and on multiple projects. Fundraising, event planning, campaign, or political experience is a plus. Familiarity with Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and Raiser’s Edge or another contact management database is a plus. All candidates should possess commitment and passion to elect Democratic pro-choice Women, as well as a commitment to the diversity of our candidates, membership, partners, and staff. The salary for this position is $55,000 and comes with a comprehensive benefits package . The starting pay for this position is equal to others at the same level throughout the organization. If you are selected for an interview, you will be contacted directly. No calls, please. Our office is based in Washington, DC. This position is based in the DC office with a hybrid schedule requiring at least 3 days per week in office. About EMILYs List EMILYs List, the nation’s largest resource for women in politics, works to elect Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ballot and across the country with a goal of fighting for our rights and our communities. Over 40 years, EMILYs List has raised $990 million to help Democratic women win competitive elections by recruiting and training candidates, supporting and helping build strong campaigns, researching the issues that impact women and families, running one of the most impactful independent expenditure operations for Democrats, and turning out women voters to the polls. Since our founding in 1985, we have helped elect the country’s first woman as vice president, 194 women to the House, 29 to the Senate, 22 governors, and over 1,600 women to state and local office. More than 40% of the candidates EMILYs List has helped elect to Congress have been women of color. Visit www.emilyslist.org for more information. EMILYs List is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values a multicultural, diverse working environment. Applicants of diverse backgrounds are welcomed and encouraged to apply. title: EMILYs List Internship - Spring 2027
body_text: EMILYs List - EMILYs List Internship - Spring 2027 EMILYs List Internship - Spring 2027 Washington, DC Internship Program / Intern / Hybrid apply for this job Gain valuable political experience and help elect Democratic pro-choice women up and down the ticket! We offer internships during the spring, summer, and fall semesters in all of our departments. Interns have the opportunity to do substantive work, while gaining in-depth experience in the political sector. In addition to daily work in their departments and attendance at staff events, interns participate in Lunch and Learn sessions, which gives them the opportunity to hear from varying levels of staff while learning about their professional history and gaining deeper knowledge about how all the departments at EMILYs List work. Our interns leave EMILYs List ready for life on the campaign trail after attending our signature Change the World training that will equip each intern with skills for beginning a career in campaigns. Interns are paid at a rate of $18.40 per hour. Interns have the flexibility to opt for a fully remote or hybrid internship experience. Hybrid interns will mutually agree on a weekly schedule for coming into the office with their respective supervisor. The internship application deadline is November 6, 2026 . We will begin reviewing applications in November. If you are selected for an interview, you will be contacted directly. No calls or emails please.
